recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中聚集多個大小不一、核分葉少或單核的異常巨核細胞（atypical megakaryocytes），右上角可見細胞質邊緣呈泡狀突起的芽細胞；巨核細胞系異常加上帶 blebs 的芽細胞，符合 ML-DS。
features: Numerous atypical megakaryocytes of variable size, many with hypolobated, monolobated or folded nuclei
Megakaryocytic cells with moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and indistinct granulation
Large cell (upper right) with coarse cytoplasmic granules and a rim of vacuolated cytoplasmic blebs
Admixed maturing granulocytes, including segmented neutrophils, and small erythroid precursors
Clustered arrangement of megakaryocytic elements in a blood-rich background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of numerous atypical megakaryocytes with variable size and predominantly hypolobated to monolobated or folded nuclei, admixed with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors. A large cell at the upper right shows cytoplasm with prominent peripheral blebs. The degree of megakaryocytic atypia and clustering is abnormal. In the setting of Down syndrome with 11% blasts, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome.

ddx.vs: In a Down syndrome child under 4 years, MDS and AML are unified as ML-DS; outside that context MDS lacks the megakaryoblast predominance and GATA1 mutation.
Morphology overlaps; constitutional trisomy 21 with somatic GATA1 mutation defines ML-DS.
ITP megakaryocytes are increased but show normal lobation without blasts or blebbed megakaryoblasts.
